findings.evidence_context: resources/email.yaml, vendor Thingiverse OpenAPI fragment: 'forgot_email: ... type: string / example: test@gmail.com' — the spec author's synthetic example for the forgot-password email field, published with the vendor spec source.

resources/footer.yaml, vendor Thingiverse OpenAPI fragment: 'email: description: the email to subscribe to the newsletter / example: john@meep.com' — synthetic placeholder example baked into the vendor's published newsletter-subscribe operation.

schemas/user_schema.yaml, vendor Thingiverse OpenAPI fragment: 'email: type: string / example: thingiverse@creativetools.se' — the vendor spec's example user object is the public CreativeTools vendor account; this is that company's published business contact address, not a customer value.

schemas/user_schema.yaml line 32, inside the example 'bio' markdown of the same public CreativeTools vendor account: 'Please [let us know](mailto:thingiverse@creativetools.se) if you have comments' — public corporate contact republished from the vendor's docs example.
